reason: A DSH web plugin that visualizes per-session token cost estimates and DeepSeek account balance in the conversation statistics row, with configurable pricing and refresh behavior.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 会话统计行中显示按模型估算的 Token 费用和 DeepSeek API 余额，并支持价格与低余额阈值配置。
summaries.en: Displays per-model session token cost estimates and DeepSeek API balance in the DSH conversation statistics row with configurable pricing and low-balance thresholds.

capabilities: Reads session event logs to estimate token costs
Displays per-model token usage and estimated costs in the web interface
Queries the DeepSeek balance endpoint using configured credentials
Stores balance results in memory with periodic refreshes
Adds configurable settings for the low-balance threshold and pricing
